accountDetails.title: Mek yu akount
accountDetails.heading: Mek yu akount
accountDetails.intro: Dis impɔtant. Kɔntinyu fɔ mek yu akount na {{ server_name }}. Yu nɔ go ebul chenj dis leta.
accountDetails.checking: De chɛk if di yuza nem de avulibul …
accountDetails.errorRequired: Dis impɔtant. Plis gi wan yuza nem
accountDetails.errorTooLong: Tumɔs lɔng, plis pik sɔntin shɔta
accountDetails.errorInvalidCharacters: Yuza nem nɔ korekt, plis yuz ɔnli {{ allowed_characters }}
accountDetails.errorNotAvailable: {{ username }} nɔ de avulibul, plis pik ɔda wan.
redirectConfirm.title: Kɔntinyu to yu akount
redirectConfirm.heading: Kɔntinyu to yu akount
redirectConfirm.trust: If yu kɔntinyu, {{ display_url }} go gɛt akses to yu akount.
ssoError.title: Lɔgin nɔ wok
ssoError.unauthorised: Yu nɔ gɛt paminshɔn fɔ lɔg in ya.
ssoError.heading: Sɔm mistek apin
ssoError.emailLinkHint: If yu de si dis pej afta yu klik wan link we dɛn sɛn to yu bay imel, mek shɔ yu klik di kɔnfɔmeshɔn link wans nɔmɔ, ɛn se yu opin di valideshɔn link insay di sem ap we yu de lɔg in frɔm.
ssoError.retryHint: Tray fɔ lɔg in bak to Pangea Chat ɛn if di prɔblɛm kɔntinyu, plis kɔntakt di savas administreta.
authSuccess.title: I wok!
authSuccess.mayClose: Yu kin kɔba dis windo naw ɛn go bak to di ap
registrationSuccess.title: Vɛrifikeshɔn wok
registrationSuccess.body: Kɔngrachuleshɔn! Yu imel dɔn vɛrifay. Plis go bak to di ap fɔ lɔg in!
passwordResetConfirm.title: Paswɔd risɛt kɔnfɔmeshɔn
passwordResetConfirm.intro: Yu dɔn rikwɛst fɔ risɛt yu Pangea Chat akount paswɔd. Klik di link dɔŋ de fɔ kɔnfɔm dis aksɔn.
passwordResetConfirm.disclaimer: If yu nɔ bin min fɔ du dis, plis kɔba dis pej ɛn yu paswɔd nɔ go chenj.
